text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thanks. I set a new personal best again today. It seems like my speed is steadily improving.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Yes, such magnificent development is the fruit of your diligent effort, Your Highness.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Your trainer's guidance also appears to be quite appropriate.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Trainer's guidance really is incredible… It's the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And Trainer is incredibly astute at identifying where I need improvement as well. My progress has noticeably increased since we joined forces.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Oh! But of course Your Highness's efforts are the greatest impetus. I merely thought your trainer's contributions are worthy of some praise.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Far more than "some." It's undoubtedly thanks to Trainer that I'm able to strive like this.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: If Your Highness thinks so highly, then I must also offer my deepest gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I have to get even better. That's surely the best way to show my appreciation!
